subject.title: fix(active-memory): recall sub-agent receives huge prompt envelopes; bound recall context to 25K chars

question: Should Active Memory’s documented `full` mode now have a fixed 25,000-character total recall-context cap for existing configurations?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes an established query-mode contract, and neither tests nor real gateway proof can determine whether reducing historical recall context for existing full-mode users is the intended product policy.

options.title: Preserve existing full-mode semantics
options.body: Limit the new bounding behavior to oversized assembled envelopes or another envelope-specific safe boundary, retaining ordinary full-mode recall behavior.

options.title: Approve the all-mode cap
options.body: Accept a 25,000-character maximum for every recall mode and make the resulting upgrade contract explicit in review and documentation.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing full-mode semantics
recommendation.body: Limit the new bounding behavior to oversized assembled envelopes or another envelope-specific safe boundary, retaining ordinary full-mode recall behavior.
